Title: Important Security Update Available ✔️

Body Text:
Your safety while playing our games is our top priority.

We've been informed of a recent security vulnerability affecting Unity. Although no malicious activity has been detected in connection with this issue, we're taking immediate action to keep our players protected.

A new update is now live on Nocturnal and includes the necessary security fixes. We strongly encourage all players to update the game as soon as possible to ensure the best and most secure gameplay experience.

You can find additional details on Unity's official website here:

Hyperlink: https://unity.com/security/sept-2025-01

**Title:**
ERMIOND

**Body Text:**
Most skelds in Differidge suffer from the deeply-rooted Continental stereotype of a grayebord man on white robes bowing before sacred oaks, taming wyverns and petitioning local lords with petitions to add yet another beast to the list of protected beasts. Erniond's old self was known for such deeds.

This book is about an individual who has been called "the leader" by his peers in Skelkide. He was a man of considerable intelligence, but also had mystical abilities and could be considered as one of those rare individuals whose skills were more than just the usual hard-working blacksmith or a well-rounded penultimate.

Erniond was known to have been obstinate and to have a tendency, quite rare in Skelkide, to consider all possible consequences for any particular course of action before it was undertaken. All this time he had been considered as an individual who demanded the considerable amount of time and patience that Erniond's self.

Given all this, one can hardly be surprised that Yennefer and his magical anomaly - stealing a priceless artifact from a private collector first being among them Then Ermiond quite out of character despite his difficult personality. However, besides her difficult character he agreed at once to work with Geralt and Gerald mentioned him as their ally.

**Note:**
The text is part of an in-game description or lore entry for the character Ermiond from The Witcher series.
